# Security

One person runs this site, with AI help. If you find a security problem, thank you for telling us.

## How to report

Email **feedback@aiconsumerrights.org** with "Security" in the subject line. Please include:

- what you found and where;
- how to reproduce it;
- what you think the impact is, and a fix if you have one.

Please don't open a public issue for something that could put visitors at risk until it is fixed.

## What to expect

- A reply within a few days.
- A fix as soon as one person can manage it, and an entry in the public [corrections log](https://aiconsumerrights.org/en/how-it-works#corrections).
- Credit by name only if you ask for it.

There is no bug bounty. Nobody is paid to work on this site.

## Please take care with the live forum

The forum's votes and suggestions are real and sit in one shared database. Please don't send bulk votes or suggestions to the live site to prove a point. A description is enough, or test against your own copy.

## What the site holds

No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. The [How this site works](https://aiconsumerrights.org/en/how-it-works) page lists every service the site uses and what each one sees.
